Key Features & Advantages

Integrated Load Limiter

Fitted with mechanical slip clutch load limiter to prevent dangerous overloading.

Electromagnetic Safety Brake

Heavy-duty electromagnetic disc brake engages instantly upon power release.

Phase Error Relay

Protects electrical components from incorrect power connection and reverse rotation.

24V Low Voltage Control

Low-voltage pendant station ensures operator safety against electric shocks.

EN 14492-2 Compliance

CE Machinery Directive

Product Overview

The Europull Electric Chain Hoist combines rapid lifting capability with pinpoint positioning accuracy. Built with durable aluminum alloy casing, high-grade helical gearing, and advanced motor cooling fins for high-duty cycle industrial manufacturing and foundry operations.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Electrical Chain Hoist are available?

The Europull Electrical Chain Hoist is available in 5 models: EPC-E05, EPC-E10, EPC-E20, EPC-E30, EPC-E50. Capacity (Tons) ranges from 0.5 Ton (500 kg) to 5.0 Ton (5,000 kg). Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Electrical Chain Hoist cover?

The Europull Electrical Chain Hoist covers 0.5t - 5t.

Which standard does the Europull Electrical Chain Hoist comply with?

The Europull Electrical Chain Hoist is manufactured to EN 14492-2 / CE.

What supply Voltage does the Europull Electrical Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Electrical Chain Hoist's supply Voltage: 3-Phase 380V / 415V 50/60Hz.

What lifting Speed does the Europull Electrical Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Electrical Chain Hoist's lifting Speed: Dual Speed (e.g. 6.8 / 2.3 m/min).

What motor & Protection does the Europull Electrical Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Electrical Chain Hoist's motor & Protection: Heavy-Duty Class F Insulation, IP55 Enclosure.
